|game_text=Deploy on table. Sense and Alter are Lost Interrupts. When any player makes a destiny draw for Sense or Alter, and that destiny draw is successful, that player loses 2 Force (may not be reduced). May deploy Bog Clearing from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. [Dagobah] Luke is a Padawan. Once per game, if [Dagobah] Luke in battle, may lose 1 Force to cancel a non-[Sense] Interrupt. Yoda and Padawans are immune to Imperial Barrier and Stunning Leader and may move for free using landspeed. While alone, Jedi Ahsoka's game text is canceled. [Immune to Alter.]

* '''PC-E2''' ([[Do, Or Do Not & •Wise Advice (V) (Errata 2)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 27 release sheet<ref name="sheet27-20261013">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF, 6 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2026”; file created 13 October 2026). Released with [[Virtual Set 27]] (9 October 2026); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 4, file created 13 October 2026: “Deploy on table. Sense and Alter are Lost Interrupts. When any player makes a destiny draw for Sense or Alter, and that destiny draw is successful, that player loses 2 Force (may not be reduced). May deploy Bog Clearing from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. [Dagobah] Luke is a Padawan. Once per game, if [Dagobah] Luke in battle, may lose 1 Force to cancel a non-[Sense] Interrupt. Yoda and Padawans are immune to Imperial Barrier and Stunning Leader and may move for free using landspeed. While alone, Jedi Ahsoka's game text is canceled. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Do, Or Do Not & •Wise Advice (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice (V)”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Do, Or Do Not & •Wise Advice (V) (Errata)]] (published 11 October 2026) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Do, Or Do Not & •Wise Advice]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
